verdict.rationale: GitLab documents several self-hosted install paths: the Linux package, official Docker images built from it, a Helm chart or Operator for Kubernetes, and self-compiling when the Linux package isn't available for your distribution. That covers OS choice and containers well. Missing for 10: any evidence of supported CPU architectures (e.g. ARM vs x86), an explicit list of supported operating systems or distributions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
